title: Microsoft Edge: v.145 - Navigation management for Progress Web Apps
description: Microsoft Edge has improved how a Progressive Web App (PWA) handles user navigation. When a user clicks a link, the browser will determine whether it should launch the installed PWA or open a new browser tab to give users a more seamless experience.
